title: Whole Boxing Ring and Separated Bag Training Workcorner
description: One static boxing-training workcorner scene, three complete existing models and zero new independent models. This is not a barbell/bench strength zone, rower/treadmill cardio pair or a recoloured old exercise corner. No old component is extracted, reshaped, recoloured or counted as a new model. Static illustrative layout only: no usable sporting equipment, boxing instruction, training efficacy, structural load, impact resistance, navigation, accessibility or safety claim.
